Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Craving another drop of sugary-sweet goodness? You’re in luck! Introducing four all-new reversible cards straight from your parents’ pantry will satisfy your hunger and enrich your collection with a taste-splosion of flavor. Fortified with wholesome mechanics, this drop is part of a complete deckfast.
Warning: Do not eat Just Add Milk: Second Helpings.
Art by Mike Burns & Scott Okumura

Contents:
• 1x Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
• 1x Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
• 1x Krark, the Thumbless
• 1x Adrix and Nev, Twincasters
